items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Well them girls would come right on over and call my mother Annie Marie.

ctx.x: They used to come down there and play. Well they'd come play on Saturday night and they wouldn't come home, they wouldn't come to New Orleans until Monday morning. See? Well them girls would come right on over and call my mother Annie Marie. And they'd get in the bed right with us, you know. Well we was all young then, you know.
